analysis.title: Costco Wholesale (COST): October sales beat expectations; traffic decelerated
key_insights: COST October core same-store sales (ex-gas/FX) rose 7.3%, above consensus of 6.4% but slower than September's 7.6%.
US comps ex-gas were +8.1% in October vs consensus +6.3% and +8.0% in September.
Cannibalization from new warehouse openings cost the company about 60bps of comp in October.
Management told GS there was no change in consumer trends or the grocery pricing environment in October.
Demand rose for toilet paper, water and canned foods in the US and many international markets amid concerns of power outages.
October inflation was consistent with the low-single-digit level called out for 4Q26. Egg deflation in food and sundries offset beef, which stayed inflationary but below mid-2025 levels.
Management believes its efficiency and supply chain model insulates Costco from freight pressure better than peers.
Worldwide traffic slowed to +4.1% in October from +4.7% in September, while global ticket ex-gas/FX accelerated to +3.1% from +2.8%.
US traffic slowed to +3.8% from +4.3% in September, while US ticket ex-gas accelerated to +4.3% from +3.7%.
The company attributed the sequential slowdown to the Labor Day timing shift, which added a little more than 50bps to September comp.
By category, Fresh grew mid-to-high single digits, Food & Sundries mid single digits, Non-foods high single digits, and the ancillary business low-to-mid thirties.
GS rates COST Buy with a 12-month price target of $1,134, 8.4% above the $1,046.47 price.

market_movers.rationale: October core comp beat consensus and ticket accelerated. Target uses relative P/E multiples of 190%/200%/210% (downside/base/upside).

earnings_insights: COST reported October sales: core SSS ex-gas/FX +7.3% vs consensus +6.4% (Consensus Metrix), reported on the 4 Nov 2026 note.
US comps ex-gas +8.1% reported vs consensus +6.3%.
GS estimates (not reported): FY8/27E EPS $22.96 diluted, FY8/28E $24.98, FY8/29E $27.21. FY8/26 actual diluted EPS $20.61.
GS quarterly EPS estimates: 11/26E $5.27, 2/27E $5.46, 5/27E $5.31. The 8/26 quarter figure is $6.60.
GS FY8/27E revenue estimate $331.1bn (+9.2% y/y) vs FY8/26 actual $303.2bn.
GS FY8/27E same store sales growth estimate is 7.0%, vs 8.4% in FY8/26.
risk_factors: Competition across grocery, convenience, big-box, other warehouse clubs and e-commerce pure-plays.
